title: Instant Autokill farm OP
features:
Best paired up with infinite yield script, use fly and tpposition
first get the RPG-7, use tpposition -1380, 322, 6081 on infinite yield with fly on
after than hold the RPG-7 and execute the script.

You will start getting insane amounts of cash, xp and kills just fly around using inf yield for as long as you like, fly near npcs.

-Made by diooverheaven8 on cord
script:
getgenv().en = true

while en do
    local otherWaifus = workspace:FindFirstChild("OtherWaifus")
    if otherWaifus then
        for _, child in ipairs(otherWaifus:GetChildren()) do
            local humanoid = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local leftLeg = child:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
            
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and leftLeg then
                local args = {
                    [1] = "Gun",
                    [2] = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("RPG-7"),
                    [3] = leftLeg,
                    [4] = {
                        [1] = {
                            ["ChargeLevel"] = 0,
                            ["ExplosionPos"] = leftLeg.Position,
                            ["ClientHitSize"] = Vector3.new(1, 2, 1),
                            ["BulletId"] = "30,12|Bullet_{BCBEDCF8-098B-4423-99D!6 7 E 0 0 E 6 2!8!B 5 }",
                            ["ModuleName"] = "1",
                            ["Distance"] = (game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.PrimaryPart.Position - leftLeg.Position).Magnitude
                        },
                        [2] = {
                            ["ChargeLevel"] = false,
                            ["ExplosionPos"] = false,
                            ["ClientHitSize"] = false,
                            ["BulletId"] = true,
                            ["ModuleName"] = false,
                            ["Distance"] = false
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("InflictTarget"):FireServer(unpack(args))
            end
        end
    end
    wait(0.1)
end
